mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, checkpoint_seq, provider, provider_session_id, runtime_id, executor_id, active_step_id, oss_ref, sha256, size_bytes, completion_result_id, gc_pending, gmt_create
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_recovery_checkpoint (tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, agent_id, checkpoint_seq, provider, provider_session_id, runtime_id, executor_id, active_step_id, oss_ref, sha256, size_bytes, completion_result_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{dispatchId}, #{agentId}, #{checkpointSeq}, #{provider}, #{providerSessionId}, #{runtimeId}, #{executorId}, #{activeStepId}, #{ossRef}, #{sha256}, #{sizeBytes}, #{completionResultId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} ORDER BY checkpoint_seq DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch old_pause WHERE old_pause.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND old_pause.id=c.dispatch_id AND (old_pause.status='PAUSED' OR (old_pause.status='CANCELED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision paused_before_cancel WHERE paused_before_cancel.tenant_id=old_pause.tenant_id AND paused_before_cancel.dispatch_id=old_pause.id AND paused_before_cancel.executor_id <=> old_pause.executor_id AND paused_before_cancel.reason_code='PAUSE_CONFIRMED'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch newer JOIN dispatch_recovery_checkpoint ready ON ready.tenant_id=newer.tenant_id AND ready.dispatch_id=newer.id AND ready.gc_pending=0 WHERE newer.tenant_id=old_pause.tenant_id AND newer.workitem_id=old_pause.workitem_id AND newer.source_type=old_pause.source_type AND newer.agent_id=old_pause.agent_id AND ready.executor_id <=> newer.executor_id AND newer.id>old_pause.id AND (newer.status='SUCCEEDED' OR (newer.status='PAUSED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision confirmed WHERE confirmed.tenant_id=ready.tenant_id AND confirmed.dispatch_id=ready.dispatch_id AND confirmed.executor_id=ready.executor_id AND confirmed.checkpoint_seq=ready.checkpoint_seq AND confirmed.reason_code='PAUSE_CONFIRMED')))))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision confirmed WHERE confirmed.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND confirmed.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND confirmed.executor_id <=> c.executor_id AND confirmed.checkpoint_seq=c.checkpoint_seq AND confirmed.reason_code='PAUSE_CONFIRMED')

(c.completion_result_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND r.result_id=c.completion_result_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.id=c.dispatch_id AND (d.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','TIMEOUT','CANCELED') OR NOT (d.executor_id <=> c.executor_id))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_recovery r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND r.cancel_requested=1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch p WHERE p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.id=c.dispatch_id AND p.status IN ('PAUSING','PAUSE_FAILED','PAUSED') AND p.executor_id <=> c.executor_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_recovery r WHERE r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND r.cancel_requested=1) AND NOT () AND ( OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch_result_decision pin WHERE pin.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND pin.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND pin.executor_id <=> p.executor_id AND pin.reason_code='PAUSE_CONFIRMED')))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatch consumer JOIN dispatch source ON source.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND source.id=c.dispatch_id WHERE consumer.tenant_id=source.tenant_id AND consumer.workitem_id=source.workitem_id AND consumer.source_type=source.source_type AND (consumer.resume_from_dispatch_id=source.id OR consumer.delivery_source_dispatch_id=source.id) AND consumer.status NOT IN ('PAUSED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','TIMEOUT','CANCELED'))
mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id,c.dispatch_id FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint c WHERE c.gc_pending=0 AND AND ( OR c.completion_result_id IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint n WHERE n.gc_pending=0 AND n.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND n.dispatch_id=c.dispatch_id AND (n.checkpoint_seq>c.checkpoint_seq OR (n.checkpoint_seq=c.checkpoint_seq AND n.id>c.id))) >= #{retain}) GROUP BY c.tenant_id,c.dispatch_id ORDER BY MIN(c.id) LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dispatch_recovery_checkpoint SET completion_result_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND id IN ( SELECT resolved_id FROM (SELECT c.id AS resolved_id FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND c.gc_pending=0 AND c.completion_result_id IS NOT NULL AND GROUP BY c.id) resolved)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND c.gc_pending=0 AND c.executor_id <=> #{executorId} AND ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dispatch_recovery_checkpoint SET gc_pending=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND id=#{id} AND gc_pending=1

UPDATE dispatch_recovery_checkpoint SET gc_pending=0 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND id=#{id} AND gc_pending=1 AND id IN (SELECT protected_id FROM (SELECT c.id AS protected_id FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND c.id=#{id} AND NOT () GROUP BY c.id) protected_rows)
UPDATE dispatch_recovery_checkpoint SET gc_pending=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dispatch_id=#{dispatchId} AND id=#{id} AND gc_pending=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE gc_pending=1 AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dispatch_recovery_checkpoint WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId} AND id = #{id}
